SRC-046:R001.text: Do not ask for ordinary "continue?" confirmation between milestones.

SRC-046:R002.text: Do not reset, clean, stash, bulk-revert, or reconstruct the tree from HEAD.

SRC-046:R003.text: Do not use git add . or git add -A as a reconciliation shortcut.

SRC-046:R004.text: Do not delete, replace, or normalize user/operator changes merely because they are unjournaled.

SRC-046:R005.text: Do not publish a public release from a dirty or provenance-ambiguous tree.

SRC-046:R006.text: Do not reimplement already-proven fixes merely because historical tickets remain open at SHIP.

SRC-046:R007.text: Do not silently weaken tests to obtain green output.

SRC-046:R008.text: Do not treat an old RC acceptance as valid after product-runtime source changes.

SRC-046:R009.text: The checkpoint must name the active ticket, phase, current dependency chain, source receipts, modified files, completed gates, residual failures, and one exact next action.

SRC-046:R010.text: T-1257 is already DONE and must not be reopened without fresh contradictory evidence

SRC-046:R011.text: every key MUST belong to COPY_KEYS, NEUTRAL_KEYS, EXCLUDED_KEYS, or DROP_KEYS

SRC-046:R012.text: classify as an intentional shippable preference

SRC-046:R014.text: malformed values must sanitize to the canonical default rather than poison the baked profile
